about: Macrodantin is supplied by brand for uncomplicated lower UTI. The 56 capsules at four a day cover 14 days.
Each nitrofurantoin supply covers seven days for uncomplicated lower UTI. The second pack is to start when the first is finished, giving 14 consecutive days.
The two separate treatment courses last seven and five days, and the intervening 14-capsule supply taken nightly is for prevention.
